jobs.title: Product Data Specialist
jobs.description:
Experience required: 2-5 years

Job Description:

Role: Product Data Specialist

About the Role:

The Product Data Specialist is responsible for creating, structuring, and maintaining the quality of product data within our ERP and PIM systems.

The role supports the integration of new product ranges into the global catalogue, working closely with local and international teams to ensure correct SKU codification, completeness of attributes, and reliability of information published to internal and digital systems (eCommerce, etc.).

This position directly contributes to structuring the product offering and to the continuous improvement of data management processes.

Key Responsibilities

SKU Creation & Management

Create new SKUs in the ERP in line with established rules

Apply codification and nomenclature standard

Update existing product records

Verify data consistency before validation

Integration of New Product Ranges

Support the onboarding of new product lines into the global catalogue

Understand the technical characteristics and structure of products

Adapt data models and attributes where required

Ensure consistency with the existing product offering

PIM Operations

Create and maintain product records in the PIM

Complete and verify mandatory attributes

Help structure product categories and families

Ensure ERP ↔ PIM synchronisation

Data Quality & Reliability

Monitor data completeness and consistency

Identify and correct errors

Track data quality metrics (KPIs)

Contribute to improving product creation workflows

Cross-functional Coordination

Collaborate with Marketing, eCommerce, and Supply Chain teams

Work with local and regional teams to collect product data

Ensure alignment of product information across regions

Gather inputs needed for product enrichment

Participate in projects to evolve tools and processes

Candidate Profile Required

Bachelor's degree (B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. / B.Com or equivalent)

2–5 years of experience in product data management / master data / ERP environments

Strong ability to understand technical products

High attention to detail and a rigorous, methodical approach

Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (lookups, pivot tables, data cleansing)

Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to work in international teams

Preferred / Good to Have

Hands-on experience with an ERP system (SAP MM / S/4HANA preferred; experience with other ERPs also valued)

Working knowledge of a PIM tool (Akeneo, Salsify, inRiver, Pimcore, etc.)

Comfort coordinating with European teams (some overlap with [CET / European] working hours may be required)

The Application Engineer – Motors is responsible for providing technical and commercial support for Low Voltage (LV), Medium Voltage (MV), and High Voltage (HV) electric motors. The role involves interpreting customer specifications, developing engineered motor solutions, supporting salesactivities, and coordinating with internal engineering teams to deliver competitive and compliant proposals.

customers. (as required)

Documentation & Data Management

We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst to join our global IT team. This employee will work with senior leadership and end users to design and deliver solutions and embody our core values - THREAD: Trust, Honesty, Respect, Excellence, Accountability, and Drive.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience working with stakeholders, and the ability to translate requirements into actionable solutions. Demonstrated success in driving project momentum, leading successful changes, and managing a broad project portfolio is strongly desired.

This role is open to candidates across experience levels (junior, mid, or senior). Responsibilities and leadership opportunities will be aligned to the candidate’s background and expertise.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document detailed requirements for new systems or enhancements.

Act as an internal consultant for software and process best practices, advising senior leadership and end users.

Create process flows, data models, mock-ups, and user interface designs to guide development teams.

Evaluate new technologies, trends, and best practices, recommending improvements to business processes and IT systems.

Document current and future state business processes and system designs.

Partner with IT teams to design, configure, and test Saas and proprietary business applications.

Develop and maintain functional documentation, including operating procedures and knowledge articles.

Provide training and support to end-users on new or updated systems and processes.

Participate in Agile/Iterative practices (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) to ensure continuous improvement and delivery.

For experienced candidates: lead or mentor junior team members, manage medium to large projects, and contribute to strategic roadmaps.

Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

Experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Functional Consultant, or similar role (level of responsibility will vary depending on years of experience):

Junior: 1–3 years of experience, strong analytical and documentation skills.

Mid-level: 4–7 years of experience, ability to manage projects and lead requirement workshops.

Senior: 8+ years of experience, proven leadership, strategic influence, and mentoring capabilities.

Strong understanding of business processes and IT systems, ideally including ERPs, integration tools such as Boomi, SQL Databases, and proprietary business applications.

Experience with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and project management practices.

Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools. SQL profiency preferred.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across cultures and time zones.

Familiarity with design and collaboration tools such as Jira, Lucid Chart, Smartsheet, or similar platforms is an advantage.

For senior candidates: experience with master data management, incident/problem management, or IT application architecture design is preferred.

CCBA, CBAP, PMI-PBA, or PMP.

SCRUM Master or Agile certifications.

NetSuite ERP Consultant or other similar certifications
